mu_name_from: MODEL_FROST_BARRIER (MODEL_SHIELD + 19), loaded from Item/Shield_20.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1118). Group 6 number 19 in OpenMU S6 Armors.cs:60.
why_this_one: The 100-140 gear MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the four second-class shields of Season 6's wave, beside the twelve weapons.
profile_from: The weapon profile, as every built shield uses.

sheet_from: Data/Item: PBshield_a.OZJ (64x128, a grey frame with blue-white frost edges, mesh 0, 236 triangles), a_2 (mesh 1, 48, the two studs), already here, and PBshield_b.OZJ (64x128, blue snowflakes on black, mesh 2, 80, the two faces), decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: The frame is grey frost-edged metal: steel at 0.45, as every broad flat piece passed in the studio.
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_FROST_BARRIER arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7236-7243): mesh 0 solid, mesh 1 (a_2) RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT, added, and mesh 2 (PBshield_b) added at BlendMeshLight |sin(WorldTime*0.001)|. Here a_2 a glow, and PBshield_b a glow at sin(WorldTime*0.002)*0.5 + 0.5 (pulse_rate half): the same 0 to 1 over the same 3.1 s as MU's |sin|, a smooth sine where MU's bounces. PartObjectColor gives it Color 29 (ZzzObject.cpp:6680). Its other draws keep mesh 0 alone (:9116, 9256). Turned down to 0 to 0.7 (pulse [0.35, 0.35]) after the studio, 2026-10-22: at full the snowflakes washed to a glare under our bloom, MU's stacked passes overshooting.
rig_note: MuMain hangs no sprites on it held (ZzzCharacter.cpp has no case). export-rig --actions=all: seven bones, one action of one key; nothing moves, no rig kept.
material_overrides_note: Steel at 0.45, as every broad flat piece passed in the studio: its own 0.2 mirrors the grass black.
